text:
ryan: kicking off a short config-only push for prod-text-gen. 12m change window. No model code. Canary plan: 4% -> 30% -> 100% with 3m soaks.

mira: changeset summary:
- tenant_limit_per_min: 2000 -> 1500
- request.timeout_s: 8 -> 6
- batching.max_batch_count: 10 -> 7
- routing: prefer fast_nodes in region=NA (mult 1.12)
- kv_cache.ttl_min: 45 -> 20

ryan: snippet:
```yaml
route: prod-text-gen
changes:
  tenant_limit_per_min: 1500
  request_timeout_s: 6
  batching_max_count: 7
  routing_pref: fast_nodes_na: 1.12
  kv_cache_ttl_mins: 20
```

deploybot: @ryan queued tag=slim-tweak-2026-03-23. Starting 4% canary. I'll post stage results.

dan: pin canary to model v2.3.0-stable for deterministic fallback?

ryan: done. canary route pinned to model:v2.3.0-stable.

deploybot: 4% live. Snapshot: p99 +2%, errors 0.03% (baseline 0.04%). Proceeding to 30% in 3m.

mira: watch kv miss rate and tenant throttles. Abort if kv_miss_rate > 35% or tenant throttled > 0.7%.

alert-bot: alert hook -> #deploy-rollbacks. Abort thresholds configured: errors > 0.6% OR p99 delta > +25% for 5m.

deploybot: 30% reached. Observability: minor p99 bump in eu-west only, overall errors flat. Rolling to 100% now with staged ramp.

ryan: temporarily soft-cap tenant media-heavy to 50% traffic for 1h to reduce tail. Applied tenant_override media-heavy:0.5.

deploybot: rollout 100% complete at 1700000288. Config applied cluster-wide. Release note: "Slimline config tweak: tenant limits, timeouts, batch cap, routing favor for NA, reduced KV TTL. Canary OK; minor eu-west p99 increase observed; media-heavy tenant soft-capped." Link: https://confluence/redwood/changes/slim-tweak-2026-03-23

mira: monitoring for 25m. Rollback plan: revert to snapshot cfg-2026-03-22-backup if sustained errors > 0.8% or p99 > baseline+40% for 10m. To trigger immediate rollback post `rollback cfg-2026-03-22-backup` in thread.

dan: acknowledged. I'll watch traces and tail buckets.

alert-bot: no aborts so far. Will notify on threshold hit. :white_check_mark:
